description:
Hlala usesikhathini ngendawo ebukhoma yomndeni wakho kanye nomlando wokuhamba—kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ufuna ukugada izingane zakho noma ukunakekela abazali asebekhulile, kulula kakhulu.

Yabelana ngokutholakala kwakho ngesikhathi sangempela, thola izaziso ezisheshayo, futhi uhlale uxhumekile kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ukuphi.

Indlela eqondile yokuvikela abathandekayo bakho.

Izici Eziyinhloko:

★ Landelela Indawo Yabo: Bona ukuthi amalungu omndeni wakho akuphi manje futhi uqaphe ukunyakaza kwawo ngqo kusuka kudivayisi yakho.

★ Thumela Indawo Yakho: Yabelana ngokushesha ngesimo sakho samanje nomndeni wakho ukuze bahlale bazi ukuthi ukuphi.

★ Izaziso Zendawo: Khetha izindawo ezibalulekile njengekhaya, isikole, noma ihhovisi. Thola isaziso ngokushesha nje lapho umzali noma ingane ifika noma ishiya lezi zindawo.

★ Umlando Wemizila: Dlulisa amehlo ezindaweni ezedlule kanye nemizila yabathandekayo bakho, bese usesha ngezinsuku ezithile.

★ Thola Izindawo Eziseduze: Thola izindawo zokudlela eziseduze, amahhotela, amabhange, nokuningi—kuhle kakhulu ekuhleleni imisebenzi yansuku zonke kanye nokuphuma.

Kuhle Kakhulu Kulokhu:

👧 Abazali abakhathazekile ngokuphepha kwezingane zabo ngaphandle

👴 Abantu abanakekela izihlobo ezindala

🏖️ Abaphathi bebhizinisi

Xhumana Nathi

Unenkinga noma unemibuzo ngenkathi usebenzisa izici zokulandelela i-GPS? Ithimba lethu lokusekela likulungele ukukusiza.

Sithinte ku: nd5star.contact@gmail.com

Isaziso Sezomthetho:

Inqubomgomo Yobumfihlo: Yonke imisebenzi kulolu hlelo lokusebenza isebenza kuphela ngemva kokuthola imvume yakho ecacile. Konke ukulandelela indawo kuqala kuphela ngemvume yakho ecacile.

Ukuvikelwa Kwedatha: Ulwazi lwendawo yakho lubethelwe futhi luvikelekile. Asilokothi sithengise noma sabelane ngedatha yakho yendawo yomuntu siqu nabantu bangaphandle. Uhlala ulawula ngokugcwele izintandokazi zokwabelana.

Ukusetshenziswa Okufanele: Ukulandelela okungagunyaziwe akuvunyelwe. Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu okwabelwana ngendawo yakhe unikeze imvume yakhe enolwazi.
